footer.description: Welcome to Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory STEM game web portal. Enjoy our library of educational STEM games which could be played on phones, tablets, and PC with no downloads necessary. If you're struggling with the concepts, ensure to use the AI features for assistance.

assistantIntro.livvyIntro: I'm Livvy! Open us from the round buttons under the game, then tap the highlighted chat icon — it's labeled "Ask AI tutors".
